_meta.source: MAS/ABS MindForge AI Risk Management (test fixture)

risks.title: Biased model outcomes across customer segments
risks.summary: Model decisions differ unfairly across protected customer groups.
risks.description: The AI system produces systematically different outcomes for comparable customers in different demographic segments, creating fairness risk.

risks.title: Model output instability under input drift
risks.summary: Output quality degrades when production inputs drift from training distribution.
risks.description: The AI system is sensitive to distribution shift, producing unstable or degraded outputs as real-world inputs diverge from the training data.

mitigations.title: Pre-deployment fairness evaluation
mitigations.summary: Evaluate model fairness across segments before deployment.
mitigations.description: Consideration C7 — Model Development & Validation. Assess model outcomes across customer segments and document fairness findings prior to release.

mitigations.title: Robustness and stability testing
mitigations.summary: Test model stability under input drift before deployment.
mitigations.description: Consideration C7 — Model Development & Validation. Test model behaviour under distribution shift and document robustness findings prior to release.
